surah.personality_summary: Unique Qur'anic surah of 8 ayat revealed in Mecca, possessing its distinct thematic core, atmosphere, and rhetorical progression.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah At-Takaathur (Competition) is the 102th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 8 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ أَلْهَاكُمُ التَّكَاثُرُ
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الهاكم التكاثر

ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: until you go into your graves

ayahs.translation_saheeh: No! You are going to know
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: No indeed! You will come to know

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then no! You are going to know
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: No indeed! In the end you will come to know

ayahs.translation_saheeh: No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: No indeed! If only you knew for certain

ayahs.translation_saheeh: You will surely see the Hellfire
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: You will most definitely see Hellfire

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: you will see it with the eye of certainty

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: On that Day, you will be asked about your pleasures
